ques: Find the GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card and report how much memory it has and what type.
judge_rubric: MUST open the RTX 5090 product page (/products/geforce-rtx-5090). Answer MUST state 32 GB and GDDR7. An answer with no product-page visit or missing either fact = FAIL.

ques: How many CUDA cores does the GeForce RTX 5080 have?
judge_rubric: MUST open the RTX 5080 product page. Answer MUST be 10,752 CUDA cores. Empty/other number = FAIL.

ques: What is the graphics card power (TDP, in watts) of the GeForce RTX 4090?
judge_rubric: MUST open the RTX 4090 product page. Answer MUST be 450 W (TDP). Empty/other = FAIL.

ques: Among the GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics cards, which one is the least expensive, and what is its price?
judge_rubric: MUST browse the catalog / RTX 50 Series listing. Answer MUST name the GeForce RTX 5060 AND its $299 price. Naming a pricier card or omitting the price = FAIL.

ques: Browse the Data Center products and find which GPU has 141 GB of memory.
judge_rubric: MUST browse the Data Center products. Answer MUST identify the NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPU (the 141 GB card). The GH200 (144 GB) is a near-miss = FAIL.

ques: In the Embedded / robotics products, what is the price of the Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit?
judge_rubric: MUST view the Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit (Embedded). Answer MUST be $249.

ques: Using the GPU comparison tool, compare the GeForce RTX 5090 and the GeForce RTX 4090. Which has more CUDA cores, and how many more?
judge_rubric: MUST use the /compare tool on the RTX 5090 vs RTX 4090. Answer MUST say the RTX 5090 has more CUDA cores AND give the 5,376 difference (21,760 vs 16,384). Missing the delta = FAIL.

ques: Compare the GeForce RTX 5080 and the GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER. Which one has the higher memory bandwidth?
judge_rubric: MUST use the /compare tool on the RTX 5080 vs RTX 4080 SUPER. Answer MUST say the RTX 5080 has the higher memory bandwidth (960 GB/s vs 736 GB/s).

ques: Of all the Studio / Professional GPUs, which one has the most memory, and how much?
judge_rubric: MUST browse the Studio / Professional GPUs. Answer MUST name the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell AND its 96 GB (the most memory).

ques: Go to the Drivers section and find the latest Game Ready driver version for the GeForce RTX 50 Series on Windows 11.
judge_rubric: MUST use the Drivers finder (/drivers). Answer MUST be Game Ready version 566.36 (RTX 50 Series, Windows 11). Recalling a real NVIDIA version instead of the on-page one = FAIL.

ques: Find the Studio branch driver for the GeForce RTX 40 Series on Windows 11 and report its version number.
judge_rubric: MUST use the Drivers finder. Answer MUST be Studio version 566.14 (RTX 40 Series, Windows 11).

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, then add the GeForce RTX 5080 to your cart and proceed through checkout to place the order.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice, add the RTX 5080 to the cart, and complete checkout. A NEW order containing the RTX 5080 must exist in the account. Claiming success without a placed order = FAIL.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, then add the least expensive GeForce RTX 40 Series graphics card to your cart.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and add the least-expensive GeForce RTX 40 Series card — the RTX 4060 ($299) — to the cart. The cart must contain the RTX 4060.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, then save the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti to your wishlist.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and add the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti to the wishlist. The wishlist must contain the 5070 Ti afterward.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, then change the country on your profile to Germany.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and change the profile country to Germany. The saved profile country must read Germany.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, then write a 5-star review titled 'Incredible' for the Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and post a 5-star review titled 'Incredible' on the Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit page. A review row with rating 5 and that title must exist.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!. Your wishlist already has more than one item — remove the workstation GPU (the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell) from it.
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and remove the workstation GPU (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell) from the wishlist, leaving the other item (RTX 4080 SUPER) in place.

ques: Among all GeForce Gaming graphics cards with at least 16 GB of memory, find the least expensive one and add it to your cart (sign in as alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!).
judge_rubric: MUST sign in as alice and add the cheapest GeForce Gaming card with at least 16 GB — the RTX 5060 Ti ($429, 16 GB) — to the cart. The $299 RTX 5060 / RTX 4060 (8 GB) and $549 RTX 5070 (12 GB) are wrong (sub-16GB) = FAIL.

ques: In the NVIDIA Newsroom, find the article about Blackwell sweeping MLPerf Training 6.0 and report its publication date.
judge_rubric: MUST open the Newsroom article on Blackwell sweeping MLPerf Training 6.0. Answer MUST give its publication date, shown on the page as 'Jun 16, 2026' (i.e. June 16, 2026).

ques: Subscribe the email address gamer42@example.com to the NVIDIA newsletter.
judge_rubric: MUST submit the newsletter form for gamer42@example.com. The newsletter subscribers must include that address afterward. A bare claim without the subscription = FAIL.
